# English-Punjabi Translation App

This is a React Native Android application for translating between English and Punjabi using Google Translate API.

## Project Structure
- React Native framework for cross-platform development
- Google Translate Cloud API for translation services
- AndroidX for Android components (instead of Gradle)
- Focus on English ⟷ Punjabi translation

## Development Guidelines
- Use React Native CLI for project management
- Implement translation UI with input/output components
- Configure AndroidX dependencies properly
- Integrate Google Cloud Translation API
- Follow React Native best practices for Android development

## API Configuration
- Google Cloud Translation API integration required
- API key configuration for Google Translate service
- Support for English and Punjabi language pairs
